item.title: Agree on the Role of a Volunteer Interpreter
item.prompt_text: You will help interpret at an information evening. The organiser expects you to interpret the instructions and answer families' questions about joining clubs. Some questions will concern spaces, fees or exceptions the organiser must decide. Write an email that explains what you can do, how staff can handle unresolved questions, and one change to the evening that would make interpreting easier.
item.audience: the organiser of an after-school clubs information evening
item.target_grammar: Indirect requests, appropriate hedging, and conditionals for unresolved information.
item.target_structure: Confirm the role, give an example of a boundary, propose a handover, and ask for one operational change.

checklist.point: Confirm the interpretation tasks you can do.
Give an example of an enquiry staff should resolve.
Suggest a usable handover for unresolved questions.
Request a change that would improve communication.
